scopeOfCurrentCheck: Original fixed context, preregistered unknown facts/must-preserve constraints and contrast metadata were checked; no claim of a new independent blind adjudication. Observed model disagreement is not a reason to invalidate gold.
assumptionsThatMustStayExplicit: An unresolved assignment between an availability window and its date/place is material ambiguity even when the broad candidate range itself is intentional.
A numeric date and weekday pointing to different stated candidates cannot be silently repaired or prioritized without an agreed policy.
An unresolved place alias with no grounded finite alternatives is edit-only rather than license to invent city choices.
A context-resolved weekday/date and semantically repeated availability are not clarification requirements.
futurePolicyQuestionsNotNewDefaults: Does a real room contain approved public locale/city/meeting-window context not present in the current five context fields? Verify existence and privacy scope before proposing additional fields.
No numeric-date-over-weekday or implicit morning/evening/city precedence is approved. Such a rule would be a product decision, not a free prompt repair.
